title: [HW2] Use a structured JSON format for inter-agent messages (P2)
prompt: Decide interpretation; if the message envelope must be JSON, wrap inter-agent turns in a structured JSON schema (round, side, content, etc.) while keeping prompts legible to the model. TDD; <=150 lines/file; ruff/mypy/coverage >=85%.
note: HW2 docs/hw2_requirements.pdf §8.3.8 — inter-agent / IPC communication should use a structured JSON format (monitorable, token-saving). Logging was already JSONL but the agent-to-agent relay hop (the controller's forward step from #219) carried only plain text. Chosen approach: introduce a structured JSON message ENVELOPE for the inter-agent hop, used as the transport + logged representation, while the text injected into the debater model stays the legible §5.6 adversarial framing (debate quality unharmed). Added packages/core/src/agent_debate/core/engine/message.py: AgentMessage pydantic v2 model with fields round:int, from_side:DebateSide, to_side:DebateSide, type:str (defaults to LOOP_RELAY_MESSAGE_TYPE='relay'), content:str (raw debater text). extra='forbid'. JSON-serialisable (model_dump_json) and round-trips losslessly (model_validate_json). AgentMessage.render(run_id) delegates to the existing build_adversarial_relay on content (single source of the '«…». Rebut it.' framing — never re-implemented) so the model still sees the legible prompt; AgentMessage.to_payload() returns model_dump(mode='json') for structured logging. Refactored engine/forward.py forward_to_opponent: it now constructs the AgentMessage envelope per hop, RENDERS the legible frame from it (envelope.render), and LOGS the JSON envelope on the existing message_routed_through_controller routing event under a new payload key 'envelope' (constants.LOOP_RELAY_ENVELOPE_KEY) — additive, NO schema break: the existing flat from/to/event payload keys and the 'system' event_type are preserved so the #219 routing contract and its tests still pass. New constants LOOP_RELAY_ENVELOPE_KEY='envelope' and LOOP_RELAY_MESSAGE_TYPE='relay' (no hard-coded values). AgentMessage exposed in engine package __all__ for SDK consumers. Isolation (5.4), adversarial framing (5.6), side-anchoring, anti-sycophancy, drift-check/nudge, 10-vs-10, word-limit, timeout/retry, verdict all unchanged. TDD red-first: packages/core/tests/test_agent_message.py drives the real engine loop offline and asserts (1) AgentMessage carries round/from_side/to_side/type/content, (2) it round-trips through JSON to an equal model, (3) render() == build_adversarial_relay(content) — legible prompt preserved, (4) each forward logs the structured JSON envelope on its routing event (re-hydrates to an equal AgentMessage per hop) with the flat from/to kept for back-compat, (5) forward_to_opponent returns the legible frame derived from content, (6) the opponent context still receives the legible frame not the raw turn. No existing test needed a payload-shape update: the #219 routing tests read payload['from']/['to'] which are preserved (additive 'envelope' key only). Gates green: ruff check + format clean, mypy clean (256 source files), check_line_limit.py exit 0 (message.py 17 code lines, forward.py 12), pytest --cov 99% total (forward.py + message.py 100%). No NEW failures vs clean main: 6 pre-existing environmental failures unchanged (2 Unix file-permission branch-protection checks, 2 live-tree secret-scan/hygiene on the developer's real .env, 2 Windows missing-file path-regex) plus the 2 long-topic parametrized teardown errors. secret_scan.py flags only the developer's real local .env (pre-existing, exit 0). docs/PRD.md NOT touched (PR #214 owns it).
